newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices fall as palm oil stocks rise.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices fall as palm oil stocks rise.

text.p: Indian castor prices fell on Friday on fresh offerings and increasing palm oil imports, dealers said.
They said the withdrawal of fresh export enquiries at higher levels triggered profit-taking.
On Friday, castorseed arrivals from Gujarat region totalled 7-8,000 bags (75 kg each) against 4-5,000 on Thursday.
Groundnut oil slid to 425/426 rupees per 10 kg from 429/430 rupees on sluggish physical demand. In Rajkot however spot oil gained by 15/20 rupees to 680/685 rupees per 15 kg.
